messages:
marta: FYI rack-12 TOR1 showing packet drops intermittently for the last 20m. Dedicated-pool-43 tail latency + token-timeouts spiking. :(

samir: saw the alerts. NIC or TOR? any pcap yet? :eyes:

marta: tcpdump shows retransmits on 10.11.12.77:9150 correlated with drops. snippet: 15:22:11.123 IP 10.11.12.77.9150 > 10.11.12.1.443 P, then RTO retransmission. No CPU/GPU high. Mostly egress bursts.

kai: can we port-shuffle that host to a different TOR port and see if drops follow? low-disruption L2 move if needed.

olivia: careful — pool-43 has AZ/rack pinning for some tenants (NVLink). Need to check allocations on host.

julian: quick query: tenant_a (dedicated, pinned), tenant_b (shared burst), infra-agent. tenant_a pinned to rack-12 for latency SLA.

samir: options: 1) port-shuffle and see if issue follows host; 2) quarantine offending host for non-pinned tenants, warm-backfill shared ones; 3) replace TOR SFP. Quarantine minimizes customer impact.

marta: propose: quarantine 10.11.12.77 (egress block for non-pinned), warm-backfill tenant_b to rack-14 same AZ, apply egress policer, run 10m verification, ops-bot run traceroutes.

ops-bot: Migration job 8823 queued: warm-backfill tenant_b -> rack-14 (same AZ). Estimated 2m.

olivia: agree. keep tenant_a in place to meet SLA, move tenant_b intra-AZ to avoid inter-AZ egress costs. also add temp rate-limit on 10.11.12.77:9150 for 30m.

julian: applied tc on host: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root tbf rate 200mbit burst 15kb latency 50ms. monitoring now.

marta: after quarantine+policer retransmits dropped to near zero over 3m. ops-bot: migration job 8823 SUCCESS. pool-43 tail latencies back to baseline. :thumbsup:

samir: nice triage. follow-ups: schedule TOR1 SFP swap tomorrow, NIC diagnostics on host, and add a detector to flag single-host egress >70% port capacity for >1m. note warm-backfill used reserved warm pool (metered) — cost owner will see a transient charge.

marta: creating short runbook and follow-up ticket for HW swap and detector. thanks.

julian: ping @networking-team for SFP window.

kai: closing once runbook posted.
